body: I think we are all forgetting this is coming from a comic book and is not meant to be perfect to be adapted as a movie, it will always drawn the fans to criticize al that could have been but couldn't, I think it is good that we have a not so serious approach all the time on these movies since initially the character can have many different versions and I think I like this reality that has been portrayed.

I am a product of the 1950s and 1960s, and growing up enjoyed the various Superman shows, TV series and movies. Early Superman shows included lots of humor and didn't take themselves too seriously.

Over the years these superhero movies became more and more dark and serious, which isn't bad, just different. This newest Superman movie is a throwback of sorts to a more comedic style, and I laughed often and hard. Some may not like this style but my wife and I were thoroughly entertained. At home, on DVD from our public library. It helps to have a nice powered subwoofer for the low bass effects.

David Corenswet is Superman and Rachel Brosnahan is Lois Lane. As we see in an early scene she already knows his double identity and they are in a relationship.

Early we learn that Superman had just thwarted a war between two fictional eastern European countries and not everyone was happy about that, particularly Lex Luthor, played very convincingly by Nicholas Hoult. He has many billions on the line.

Lots of action but also a few references to modern society, like the vanity of using your phone for 'selfies' and posting to social media. But it also includes such esoteric references as black holes, portals, and 'pocket universes'.

This is a nicely entertaining movie, I don't get the very negative comments, they are not deserved.

The superman movie really said: No one is alien. "everyone" is a person. Billionaires are evil. War is created. Journalism is important. Empathy is a superpower. Kindness isn't weakness, It's resistance. Hope isn't naive, It's necessary. Power means nothing if you don't use it to protect the powerless. Truth doesn't shout, It stands. Being gentle in a cruel world is a revolutionary act. You don't need to punch to be strong. Saving people doesn't make you soft, it makes you brave. Real strength is choosing compassion over anger. You don't have to always be from where you fight for.

And being soft hearted is THE PUNK ROCK.

Let's be honest, this is far from perfect but for once in cinema I've never been so appreciative of nerds, and that's no insult, James Gunn has made nerds cool again.

This is a character that has been used in countless projects wether it be movies or TV shows and while taking characteristics from the iconic Superman, almost all have failed at getting to the heart of the superhero. And credit to Gunn, he's done his research, this is not just a filmmaker who has a terrific knowledge of effects, he understands the source material and the fan base. And for the first time since Christopher Reeve, I think the character is finally in the right hands.

Like I said, as a movie, it is far from perfect, I think as a new chapter for this character it's a terrific start, I'm happy we didn't have to restart with a origin story because I personally couldn't handle another one, this is Kent/Superman already in his element and it's a great introduction. But this movie has to be ultimately just that, a introduction. The formula that made this movie successful is something that will need to be tweaked, before it runs the risk of becoming over familiar.

I know it has it's fans, but Snyder's universe of these characters had promise, but it failed dramatically in the end, it was a terrible mess. Like it or not DC movies will always be compared to the Marvel universe, and if we are talking box office numbers or review ratings or even legacy, Marvel won that fight. But this movie has promise that maybe the scales can be tilted if done right.

This movie has a lot of effects, which are very impressively clean, it's colourful and it looks terrific. I think it just about manages to have the right amount of characters who are brilliantly cast. But there are points where anymore character introductions would of been one to many, and that's something it really needs to be wary of in the future. Also I admit if you not already aware of characters attributed to Superman you may be overwhelmed with this movie.

What the movie does well is it puts this franchise in a great starting position for the future, this movie gives but a taste of a multitude of very likeable and iconic characters and now that we know them, what happens next is what is important.

Of course effects and action sequences are essential, but for this to have a future, learn from past mistakes from both DC and Marvel, the story has to come first. It's not just about having memorable villians, the story needs heart and it needs to evolve. Bad guy Vs good guy is something all movies will essentially do, if this new Superman can have a story with some emotion in it, something that can actually resonate with the audience over then the future could potentially be great.

In conclusion, love the new cast, i think everyone does extremely well, David Corenswets version of Superman has been the most exited I've been about superman since Reeves, I had doubts on Hoult as Luther but he was great as was Brosnahan as Lois Lane.

But it's still early days. What happens next is what is important, but if this is anything to go by, I'm very exited to see what they come up with next. Highly recommend.

I have always been a marvel guy over DC and never really liked Superman especially the DCEU one, Henry Cavils Superman was boring and dark. That's not what Superman is supposed to be, he's a symbol of hope. This Superman delivers, it's bright, colorful, funny, and they made Superman interesting. I know a lot of people want him to be an invincible character but then there would be no suspense since you know whatever they throw at him he will be ok, except kryptonite. I do think the middle is a little slow at times but mostly it's good. The side characters are also so peak. Guy Gardener is the goat along with the rest of the justice gang. This one movie single handedly saved the DC universe. It was overall a solid start to a new universe and it was my second favorite superhero movie of the year and in my top 10 favorite movies of 2025.
